text: Design cleanup: cross-cutting pass (confirm dialogs, destructive colours, button and label styles) and screenshots

Leftovers from the per-screen tickets, also in scope here:
- The Accounts drag handle's semantics node is 24dp; give it the 48dp Box the category handle got.
- Two keys for the same back link: web list.backToList (registry) and listProps.backToList; keep one.
- The list screen's control icons are 40dp (rest of C6); 48dp.
- The Android overview invite card does not wrap its buttons under the name when space runs out (web does).
- The admin registration switch's knob stays white on the dark red (2.8:1); use the on-red colour.
- The ledger's empty state in the same muted, start-aligned style as the others (A20).
- The expense type is still native radios on the web and a SegmentedButton on Android; use the web's .segmented-choice.
- window.confirm now also covers the expense delete and the category merge; every one goes to the ConfirmDialog.
